headline: The Netherlands Shifts Public Infrastructure to NixOS
lede: The Dutch government is migrating its IT stack to a reproducible, open-source foundation. By adopting NixOS, officials aim to strip away proprietary layers in favor of verifiable, modular systems.

headline: Ink and Switch Marks a Decade of Local-First Computing
lede: For ten years, this research lab has pushed back against the cloud-native status quo. Their new interactive homepage invites users to explore a history of tools built for data ownership and human collaboration.

headline: M6 Mac Minis Successfully Emulate a 600MHz Pentium II
lede: High-frequency emulation relies on more than just raw power. Testing confirms that the single-threaded performance of modern Apple silicon sustains cycle-accurate timing for classic hardware environments.

headline: F-Droid 2.0 Modernizes the FOSS App Repository
lede: The Android FOSS ecosystem receives a significant overhaul with a complete transition to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. This update improves search and installation reliability while reducing long-term technical debt.

headline: Italian Mafia Syndicates May Be Blocking Fentanyl Distribution
lede: Local criminal organizations appear to be prioritizing stable, traditional drug markets over the scrutiny brought by synthetic opioids. This suggests a rare, inadvertent alignment between illicit market control and public health.
pullquote: Organized crime is prioritizing traditional revenue streams over the volatile risk of synthetic epidemics.

headline: Kernel Privilege Escalation Found in Avast Antivirus
lede: A double-fetch vulnerability in the Avast kernel driver allowed for arbitrary read and write operations. The exploit demonstrates the persistent danger posed by over-privileged security software on modern Windows systems.

headline: Revisiting OpenAI's Foundational 2016 Research Roadmap
lede: A decade ago, the lab identified four core areas for long-term AI safety and capability. The document serves as a case study in sticking to a singular research vision through rapid organizational growth.

headline: Bastardica Tool Generates Experimental Hybrid Fonts
lede: Browser-based Python execution allows users to warp and stretch existing typefaces into entirely new, cursed combinations. The resulting files leverage OpenType ligatures to bring digital chaos to any text editor.

headline: Whiteboard Simplifies Complex AI-Generated Codebases
lede: Autonomous coding agents often obscure the logic behind their changes, creating a new form of cognitive debt. This open-source IDE visualizes system architecture and semantic diffs to help engineers regain oversight.

headline: The Evolutionary Trade-Off Behind Liver Regeneration
lede: Why does the human liver regenerate while other organs fail? The answer lies in a biological cancer tax, where evolution limits cell growth in most tissues to protect the body against malignancy.
